name: quizell
label: Quizell
description: Quiz-based product recommendation and lead capture platform.

token.label: API Token
token.description:
To get your Quizell API token:
1. Log in to your [Quizell](https://quizell.com) account.
2. Go to **Settings** in the left sidebar.
3. Navigate to **API & Integrations**.
4. Copy your API token from there.

Need help? See [Quizell API Docs](https://docs.quizell.com).

create_customer.label: Create Customer
create_customer.description: Creates a new customer (quiz lead) in Quizell.

quiz_id.label: Quiz ID
quiz_id.description: The ID of the quiz this customer responded to. Find it in your Quizell dashboard under the quiz settings URL (e.g. the number at the end of quizell.com/quiz/12345).

note.label: Note
note.description: An internal note about this customer.

update_customer.label: Update Customer
update_customer.description: Updates an existing customer record in Quizell.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to update. Use the "List Customers" or "Get Customer" actions to find this ID.

quiz_id.label: Quiz ID
quiz_id.description: The ID of the quiz associated with this customer.

note.label: Note
note.description: An internal note about this customer.

list_customers.label: List Customers
list_customers.description: Retrieves a list of customers (quiz leads) from Quizell.

search.label: Search
search.description: Filter customers by name or email. Leave empty to return all customers.

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number for results. Starts at 1.

per_page.label: Results Per Page
per_page.description: How many customers to return per page. Maximum is 100.

get_customer.label: Get Customer
get_customer.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer by their ID.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to retrieve. Use the "List Customers" action to find customer IDs.

search_products.label: Search Products
search_products.description: Searches for products in your Quizell catalog by title or SKU.

title.label: Product Title
title.description: Search by product name. Leave empty to return all products.

sku.label: SKU
sku.description: Search by product SKU (stock keeping unit). Leave empty to skip this filter.

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number for results. Starts at 1.

per_page.label: Results Per Page
per_page.description: How many products to return per page.

create_product.label: Create Product
create_product.description: Adds a new product to your Quizell product catalog.

title.label: Product Title
title.description: The name of the product as it will appear in quiz recommendations.

price.label: Price
price.description: The selling price of the product (e.g. 29.99).

status.label: Status
status.description: Whether this product is active and visible in quizzes.

sku.label: SKU
sku.description: Your internal stock keeping unit code for this product.

image.label: Image URL
image.description: A publicly accessible URL to the product image (e.g. https://example.com/product.jpg).

vendor.label: Vendor / Brand
vendor.description: The brand or vendor name for this product.

quantity.label: Quantity in Stock
quantity.description: The available quantity for this product.

compare_at_price.label: Compare-At Price
compare_at_price.description: The original price to show a discount (e.g. 49.99). Leave empty if there is no sale.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Comma-separated tags to categorize this product (e.g. "skincare, moisturizer, sensitive-skin").

detail_link.label: Product Page URL
detail_link.description: The URL to the product page in your online store.

external_id.label: External ID
external_id.description: The product ID from your external system (e.g. Shopify product ID) for syncing.

update_product.description: Updates an existing product in your Quizell product catalog.
